pace.observed: Most clauses carry a physical change. Two near-static stretches of about 3 s each (6.8 to 10.0 s, 18.6 to 21.8 s) and a quiet tail from 41 s. None exceeds 5 s without change.

closing_answer.observed: Evaluating use and experience tag pins to the usage slider (39.4 s). Wide cut at 41.6 s shows Answer with Sources filled, Accuracy empty and both Not in release tags, with the ring pulsing at 42.2 to 42.6 s. This resolves the opening's 'answer with sources'. It is followed by the credits card at 44.0 s.

finished_art.observed: Consistent finished vector-dimensional style: soft shadows, screws and glow, readable type, anonymous hands and badges. Weak spots: window plate reads savanna rather than Gulf, plain lined-paper backgrounds in s4/s6/s7, and card cropped at frame edge in s6.

clauses.observed: Hands type on a keyboard, Question card fills, card slides to the OpenEvidence AI tool (0.8 to 1.2 s), then the tool holds with chasing indicator dots until 2.8 s.
Answer card with Sources and Accuracy slots emerges below the tool at 3.2 s. Three labelled citation cards (Medical literature, Clinical guidelines, Other sources) tuck into Sources by 4.8 s.
Camera pulls to the record boundary and an Announced September 22nd tag pins at 6.6 s. Date is pictured but then a mostly static hold from about 7.0 s to 9.9 s with only an underline drawing.
Live since March tag swings in at 10.6 s and settles on the same record boundary by 11.0 s.
Two hands type masked dots into the Usual credentials field (12.4 to 13.4 s) and the padlock shackle lifts at about 13.6 to 14.0 s.
Hand types into the Question card with a Plain language field; text lines fill from 15.0 to 15.6 s.
Answer card with filled Sources slot. Citation cards emerge from Sources and fan upward from 17.2 to 18.0 s.
Medical literature card glows and lifts at about 19.8 s, Clinical guidelines glows at about 20.6 s. Labels are readable. Only glows and small lifts, so the action is gentle.
Board of 12 clinician badges lights one by one from 22.4 s, a slider fills past the Half tick and More than half appears (23.4 to 24.4 s), then a Clinical decision support tag pins at 25.2 to 25.6 s.
UTMB's own report tag swings in and pins to the slider end by 28.2 s.

After a cut, the Answer card appears. Accuracy then Patient care tags clip on (30.2 to 30.6 s) and 'Not in release' text resolves by 32.0 s. The Accuracy slot is cropped off-frame and tags cover Sources, so the empty slot isn't visible in this clause.
Medical literature card rises, a teal thread draws from it to the Sources slot at 34.4 to 35.0 s and glows to the end. Source type is shown pointing back.
Camera pushes in at 36.8 s on the Answer card. The dashed Accuracy slot warms and the empty ring pulses at 37.2 to 38.4 s, and nothing lands in it.
An Evaluating use and experience tag pins to the usage slider (39.4 to 39.8 s). A cut at 41.6 s shows the Answer card with both Not in release tags and the Accuracy ring pulsing at 42.2 to 42.6 s.
